reason: All available evidence (homepage, About Us, The Village, Floorplan & Stores, and Restaurants pages of www.helsinkioutlet.fi) describes 'Helsinki Outlet', a retail shopping outlet village on Ring Road III between Helsinki and Vantaa (address: Tatti 17, 00760 Helsinki). The site offers ~40 clothing/home/beauty/sports brand stores, an online shop, on-site restaurants (Espresso House, Pizza Hut, Villa Severino, seasonal Pingviini Ice Cream Kiosk), and a children's play area (Leo's Leikkimaa). No page in the retrieved evidence bundle (including About Us/Our Story, The Village, Floorplan & Stores, Restaurants) mentions any room, bed, overnight stay, check-in/out, or lodging offering of any kind. This business profile matches the Shops product type (closest categories: 'shopping_center', 'outlet' in the Shops taxonomy group) rather than Accommodation. Because this run's product_type is fixed as 'accommodation' and no accommodation/lodging product can be identified anywhere on the site, the product boundary for an Accommodation record cannot be resolved -- there is no candidate to select, so no 'product' value can be recorded. This is recorded as ambiguous/unresolved scope (closest available error_code) rather than a false 'resolved' Accommodation record, per the instruction to never invent product facts.
